# Scraper
```{r}
school_names = c(
  "arizonawildcats" = "Arizona",
  "thesundevils"    = "Arizona State",
  "baylorbears"     = "Baylor",
  "byucougars"      = "BYU",
  "gobearcats"      = "Cincinnati",
  "cubuffs"         = "Colorado",
  "uhcougars"       = "Houston",
  "cyclones"        = "Iowa State",
  "kuathletics"     = "Kansas",
  "kstatesports"    = "Kansas State",
  "okstate"         = "Oklahoma State",
  "gofrogs"         = "TCU",
  "texastech"       = "Texas Tech",
  "ucfknights"      = "UCF",
  "utahutes"        = "Utah",
  "wvusports"       = "West Virginia"
)

urls = c(
  "https://arizonawildcats.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://baylorbears.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://cubuffs.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://uhcougars.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://cyclones.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://kuathletics.com/sports/football/roster/",
  "https://kstatesports.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://okstate.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://gofrogs.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://texastech.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://utahutes.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://wvusports.com/sports/football/roster"
)

roster_function = function(roster_url){
  webpage = rvest::read_html(roster_url)
  
  # Get player cards first
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".s-person-card") -> cards
  
  # Names
  cards |> rvest::html_element("h3") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
  
  # Position
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(1)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
  position = stringr::str_remove(position, "Position ")
  
  # Year
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(2)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year
  year = stringr::str_remove(year, "Academic Year ")
  
  # Height
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(3)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height
  height = stringr::str_remove(height, "Height ")
  
  # Weight
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(4)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, "Weight ")
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")
  
  # Hometown
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-card__content__person__location-item") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
  hometown = stringr::str_remove(hometown, "Hometown")
  split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
  city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
  state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])
  
  # Previous school
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-card__content__person__previous-school-item") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
  prev_school = stringr::str_squish(prev_school)
  prev_school = stringr::str_remove(prev_school, "^.*:\\s*")
  prev_school = dplyr::na_if(prev_school, "")
  
  # Current school
  site = stringr::str_extract(roster_url, "(?<=://)[^.]+")
  school = unname(school_names[site])
  
  # Make the data frame
  df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                  height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                  hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                  previous_school = prev_school)
  
  # Drop coach/staff cards (no listed position)
  df = df[!is.na(df$position), ]
  
  return(df)
}

big12_df = data.frame()
for (url in urls) {
  df = roster_function(roster_url = url)
  
  big12_df = rbind(big12_df, df)
  
  Sys.sleep(2)
}
```
```{r}
urls2 = c(
  "https://thesundevils.com/sports/football/roster?view=list",
  "https://gobearcats.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://ucfknights.com/sports/football/roster?view=list",
  "https://byucougars.com/sports/football/roster?view=list"
)

roster_function2 = function(roster_url){
  webpage = rvest::read_html(roster_url)
  
  # Get player cards first
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".roster-list-item") -> cards
  
  # Names
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-list-item__title") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
  
  # Position
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--position") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
  position = stringr::str_remove_all(position, "\\[|\\]")
  
  # Year
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--class-level") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year
  year = stringr::str_remove_all(year, "\\[|\\]")
  
  # Height
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--height > span") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height
  height = stringr::str_remove(height, "Height ")
  
  # Weight
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--weight") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
  weight = stringr::str_remove_all(weight, "\\[|\\]")
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")
  
  # Hometown
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--hometown") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
  hometown = stringr::str_remove(hometown, "Hometown")
  hometown = stringr::str_remove_all(hometown, "\\[|\\]")
  split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
  city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
  state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])
  
  # Previous school (NA for players who didn't transfer)
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--previous-school") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--high-school") |> rvest::html_text2() -> high_school
  prev_school = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_remove_all(prev_school, "\\[|\\]"))
  high_school = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_remove_all(high_school, "\\[|\\]"))
  
  prev_school = stringr::str_remove_all(prev_school, "\\[|\\]")
  prev_school = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(prev_school, "(HS|High School|School|Academy|Prep)$"),
                       NA, prev_school)
  
  college = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(high_school, "/"),
                   stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_remove(high_school, "^[^/]*/")),
                   NA)
  prev_school = ifelse(is.na(prev_school) | prev_school == "", college, prev_school)
  
  # Current school
  site = stringr::str_extract(roster_url, "(?<=://)[^.]+")
  school = unname(school_names[site])
  
  # Make the data frame
  df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                  height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                  hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                  previous_school = prev_school)
  
  # Drop coach/staff cards (no listed position)
  df = df[!is.na(df$position), ]
  
  return(df)
}

df = data.frame()
for (url in urls2) {
  df = roster_function2(roster_url = url)
  
  big12_df = rbind(big12_df, df)
  
  Sys.sleep(2)
}
```
